name: sprintwell
description: Sprintwell: real-time tools for Agile teams to run their own Scrum events, planning poker and retrospectives.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:cf: npm run build -w web && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.test:cf: SPRINTWELL_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 npm test -w server -- test/api.test.ts test/meetings.test.ts test/gitlab-auth.test.ts test/classes.test.ts
